content:
Last week saw notable price drops on several current Apple products, ranging from 25% off the AirPods Pro 3 to $120 off the latest AirPods Max 2, but the deals aren't over yet. While those offers are still valid, Amazon has just dropped the price of the 2026 AirTag 2 to its lowest ever — with units now going for as little as $20 each.

Last week as part of the anniversary promotions, we already covered several all-time low prices on the AirTag 2 — if you missed out, don't worry, prices have now dropped even lower to the best we've tracked.

Amazon is still listing the single AirTag 2 at $24 — matching the lowest price we've seen since launch — but the 4-pack has been reduced to $79.99 with free shipping.

Apple's official 4-pack is priced at $99, which already makes the per-unit cost cheaper than the usual $29 for a single unit, and now it's going for nearly 20% off, an all-time low at just $20 per AirTag 2.

While the previous $90 deal on the 4-pack will likely stick around alongside major anniversary sales at retailers through the end of the week, Amazon's new all-time low is different — no one knows when the price will go back up.

We've previously covered the differences between the previous-generation AirTag and this year's AirTag 2 — you can check that out here — but here's a quick recap:

  • Precision Finding range is 1.5x further than before
  • Volume is 50% louder than the original
  • AirTag 2's built-in speaker is 'audible at twice the distance'
  • Offers 'an industry-first series of anti-stalking safeguards'

AirTag 2's new features are just around the corner

The AirTag 2 dropping to $20 each comes just ahead of iOS 27 and watchOS 27 launching next month. For Apple Watch users, there's a nice upgrade: the Find My app now has Precision Finding support. That means you can use your Apple Watch with on-screen arrows and specific distance info to locate an AirTag.

watchOS 27 also unifies the Find My experience within a single app. Previously, the Find My experience on Apple Watch was split into three separate app icons in the app list or directory: 'People', 'Items', and 'Devices'.

Meanwhile, iOS 27 brings a new design and interface tweaks to the Find My app, making it easier to track people and items.

With that in mind, now is the perfect time to expand your AirTag 2 collection — especially at these prices.

More of this week's best Apple deals:

  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
